2607.26604.title: WikiLoop: Jointly Learning to Build and Navigate Agent-Native Wikis with Downstream Feedback
2607.26604.paper_summary: Knowledge-base construction and querying are typically optimized in isolation: retrieval-augmented agents operate over a fixed, externally maintained index, whereas construction receives no signal from downstream use. We present WikiLoop, a feedback-coupled framework that jointly learns to build and navigate an agent-native Wiki, a persistent linked-page knowledge base designed for machine navigation. A role-conditioned shared policy supports two interfaces: a Navigator retrieves evidence from the Wiki to answer queries, and a Builder proposes structured edits evaluated through downstream navigation. The Navigator follows a sufficiency-before-efficiency objective that applies retrieval-cost penalties only after full evidence has been collected. The Builder learns from utility differences: a frozen Navigator scores each candidate edit by its change in downstream performance, while a guard penalty discourages regressions on unrelated queries. Training combines sequential role-specific optimization with a final joint stage over role-homogeneous batches. With Qwen3.5-9B as the common backbone, WikiLoop reaches 62.6 aggregate Answer Correctness on AuthTrace, 6.3 points above LLM-Wiki, base, with the largest gains on multi-document queries. Controlled comparisons support the intended effects of both objectives, and the learned edits remain useful to a held-out Navigator. Paired comparisons indicate that the final shared policy largely retains both role-specific capabilities, improves Navigator and end-to-end Answer Correctness by 0.4 points relative to the corresponding specialist references, and consolidates both interfaces into one model. Without dataset-specific training, WikiLoop also improves over the same-backbone LLM-Wiki, base on HotpotQA and MuSiQue.
2607.26604.paper_summary_zh: 知識庫的構建和查詢通常是孤立優化的：增強檢索的代理在固定的、外部維護的索引上運作，而構建則沒有來自下游使用的信號。我們提出了WikiLoop，一個反饋耦合的框架，聯合學習構建和導航一個代理原生的維基，這是一個為機器導航設計的持久鏈接頁面知識庫。一個角色條件的共享策略支持兩個接口：導航器從維基中檢索證據以回答查詢，而構建者則提出結構化的編輯，這些編輯通過下游導航進行評估。導航器遵循一個充分性優先於效率的目標，僅在收集到完整證據後才施加檢索成本的懲罰。構建者從效用差異中學習：一個凍結的導航器通過下游性能的變化來評分每個候選編輯，而一個防護懲罰則會抑制對無關查詢的退步。訓練結合了順序角色特定優化和最終在角色同質批次上的聯合階段。以Qwen3.5-9B作為共同的骨幹，WikiLoop在AuthTrace上達到了62.6的總體答案正確率，比LLM-Wiki的基準高出6.3分，並在多文檔查詢上獲得了最大的增益。受控比較支持這兩個目標的預期效果，並且學習到的編輯對於保留的導航器仍然有用。配對比較表明，最終的共享策略在很大程度上保留了角色特定的能力，相對於相應的專家參考，導航器和端到端答案正確率提高了0.4分，並將兩個接口整合為一個模型。在沒有數據集特定訓練的情況下，WikiLoop在HotpotQA和MuSiQue上也優於相同骨幹的LLM-Wiki基準。
